neighbours.label: 'time' completing the temporal frame 'at a time' (at a time when / at a time of)
fire: The museum reopened at a time when tourism was collapsing.
He took the job at a time of great uncertainty in the industry.
The law passed at a time when few people owned cars.
She started painting at a time when women were rarely exhibited.
These cuts come at a time of rising food prices.
The band formed at a time when punk was fading.
At a time when trust is low, honesty matters more than ever.
The bridge was built at a time of rapid growth in the city.
quiet: The museum reopened after a long time of repairs.
He took the job the first time it was offered.
The law passed with time to spare before the election.
She started painting at a young age in her village.
These cuts come at a cost to families across the region.
The band formed at a party in a friend's garage.
Over time, trust between the partners slowly grew.
The bridge was built in record time by the city.

notes: 15 of the top 32 peak on ' time', almost all in 'at a time when/of'. Near misses split: 'time' outside the frame, or 'at a' followed by another noun.
